subject: Re: HelioWorks / Redwood co-sell marketplace demo — slot coordination

Subject: HelioWorks x Redwood — marketplace co-sell demo?

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the intro at the partner summit last month — Priya and I were excited to hear about Redwood's marketplace play. We have an AWS Marketplace listing draft and a short technical runthrough we think would resonate with joint prospects (SI partners are asking for a joint walkthrough before committing).

Would Redwood be open to a 45-minute co-sell demo that covers:
- Quick overview of HelioWorks integration with AWS/GCP
- Redwood runtime + marketplace listing workflow (2 demos)
- Q&A for SI partner enablement (15 mins)

We can do next week. Current availability (PST): Tue 7/20 10:00–12:00, Wed 7/21 11:00–14:00.

If those don't work, happy to propose alternate windows. Also happy to send a short deck and a pre-req checklist.

Best,
Alex Reed
Head of Partnerships | HelioWorks
alex.reed@helioworks.com | +1 (415) 555-0183

Hi Alex — great to hear from you and thanks for outlining the agenda. Vanessa (partnerships PM) and Karthik (solutions lead) are looping in for the technical bits and SI enablement discussion.

We can make a 45-minute slot work. Proposed options (PST):
- Tue 7/20 10:30–11:15 (tight, but doable)
- Tue 7/20 11:30–12:15 (better for Q&A)
- Wed 7/21 12:00–12:45 (best for engineering attendees)

Two quick asks before we lock:
1) Can you share the small deck and any architecture diagram so Karthik can pre-assign talking points?
2) Are any SI partners expected to join live? If so, please CC them or list names so we can include an enablement segment.

I'll tentatively hold Tue 7/20 11:30–12:15 PT on my calendar and send a formal invite; please confirm which of the three options you prefer.

Thanks — Monica
